blinding_note: The Meneses et al. manuscript and repository summaries were inspected during source qualification. Published dose-dependent PMF collapse, TMRM depolarization, cell shrinkage/recovery, and partial motor adaptation are therefore known. The frozen test evaluates source reproduction, joint representation, rate-depth dissociation, and scalar eligibility; it does not claim blinded discovery.

upstream.article: Meneses et al. (2026), Osmotic Stress Triggers Fast and Reversible PMF Collapse in Escherichia coli, Biophysical Journal

biological_event.system: Escherichia coli MG1655 osmotic stress response
biological_event.whole_event: shock-conditioned collapse and recovery of cellular energetic and physical state, measured by flagellar motor speed, TMRM membrane-potential signal, and cell area
biological_event.target_observable_power: direct: high-time-resolution motor dynamics plus orthogonal membrane-potential and cell-area assays

source_native_processing.immediate_drop_fit: A/(1+exp((t-175-t0)/tau))+C on 175-240 s using source initial guesses
source_native_processing.immediate_recovery_fit: B*(1-exp(-(t-270)/tau))+D on >270-360 s using source initial guesses
source_native_processing.sustained_baseline: mean speed for time < 180 s after source 1 s median filter
source_native_processing.tmrm: per-track deltaF/F0 using 10 pre-shock frames before frame 35; 5 s frames
source_native_processing.cell_area: per-track deltaA/A0 using 10 pre-shock frames before frame 35; 5 s frames

representation_hierarchy.Bio_Chi: the whole dose-conditioned energetic/physical collapse-and-recovery relation across motor, TMRM, and cell area
representation_hierarchy.Chi_bio: candidate condition-level multicoordinate state consisting of motor collapse amplitude, motor collapse tau, motor post-removal recovery tau, sustained motor recovery tau, sustained plateau, TMRM minimum and post-recovery level, and cell-area minimum and post-recovery level
representation_hierarchy.chi_bio: NOT_OPENED_AT_FREEZE. Source sigmoid/exponential taus are descriptive summary parameters and are not mechanistic damping-mode carriers. They cannot be relabeled chi_bio without an independently licensed dynamical reduction.

source_reproduction: reproduce source trace counts for all four immediate and sustained motor conditions
reproduce TMRM and cell-area population summaries within absolute tolerance 0.005 for normalized amplitudes and 5 s for minimum-time summaries

depth_coordinates: immediate motor fitted drop amplitude A_dec
rate_depth_dissociation.condition_summary: median per concentration for motor fit parameters
rate_depth_dissociation.dose_trend_metric: Spearman rho across ordered concentrations 200,300,400,500 mM
rate_depth_dissociation.candidate_rate_stable_depth_variable_rul: both depth coordinates must show |rho| >= 0.8 in the source-expected direction, while all three rate coordinates must have |rho| <= 0.4 and max/min positive condition median ratio <= 1.5. This label is descriptive P0-Q only and is not proof of invariant kinetics.

joint_representation.standardization: z score by coordinate across the four shock strengths
joint_representation.one_dimensional_adequacy_rule: PC1 variance fraction >= 0.95 AND maximum absolute standardized 1D reconstruction residual <= 0.10
joint_representation.disposition_if_pass: ONE_DIMENSIONAL_CONDITION_COMPRESSION_ADEQUATE_P0Q; this still does not license chi_bio

failure_and_refusal_rules: source download or schema mismatch is preserved as source/interface failure
fit failures remain in the denominator and are reported by condition; no post-result cell removal
published qualitative agreement does not rescue failed reproduction
a successful one-dimensional compression does not become chi_bio without a mechanistic carrier
a failed one-dimensional compression cannot be rescued by selecting a subset of coordinates after inspection
claim_ceiling: direct experimental P0-Q representation qualification in one E. coli osmotic-stress system; no universal biological chi value, no universal boundary, and no causal molecular mechanism beyond the source evidence
